description.en:
Empties the match's tough list: every entry added with CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_TOUGH or CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_TOUGH_ONLY_TP is cleared at once (32 entries), so all players pay their GP, TP and Fighting Spirit gauge costs again.
Players in the forced-win list keep those protections; use CMND_BTL_RESET_FORCE_WIN for them.
No shipped script calls it; they remove players one by one with SET_FORCE_TOUGH(false, ...).

examples.case: Dropping every tough entry in a result callback (not found in script_clean/; invented)
